papers.title: Study on Fatigue Behavior and Life Prediction of Laser Powder Bed Fused Ti6Al4V Alloy at 400 °C
papers.abstract: Additive manufacturing has huge development potential in the aerospace field. The hot-end components of aeroengines work in harsh environments, facing high temperatures and a demand for long service life. In this paper, high-cycle fatigue (HCF) tests of Ti6Al4V alloy at 400 °C by selective laser melting (SLM) under different stress ratios (-1, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, and 0.8) were carried out, and the fracture surfaces were observed. The results show that the defects existing on the surface or subsurface are prone to become the origin of fatigue cracks. There is a large dispersion of the high-cycle fatigue life of the samples, especially at a low stress ratio. With the increase in the stress ratio, the fatigue failure area on the fracture surface gradually decreases, and the fracture surface gradually presents a mixed pattern of tensile endurance fracture and fatigue failure. Considering the influence of creep damage due to mean stress, models were established, respectively, for the fatigue behavior and time-related rupture behavior to predict fatigue life and conduct an assessment. Then, the two models were combined and the composite models were proposed using the linear damage law. Finally, the single fatigue model and rupture models, as well as the composite models, were evaluated, respectively, and compared with the actual fatigue life, and the best model was obtained for the high-cycle fatigue prediction of SLM Ti6Al4V at 400 °C.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接涉及激光粉末床熔融Ti6Al4V合金在高温下的高周疲劳行为，与用户关注的增材制造钛合金力学及疲劳性能方向高度一致。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on fatigue at 400°C rather than room temperature, and does not include post-processing treatments or implant structures.

summary_zh.motivation: 高温环境下增材制造Ti6Al4V疲劳性能研究不足，需建立寿命预测模型。
summary_zh.method: 进行不同应力比下400°C高周疲劳试验，结合断口观察和线性损伤法则建立复合预测模型。
summary_zh.result: 缺陷易成为裂纹源，应力比增大使疲劳区减小，复合模型预测效果最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实际疲劳寿命对比评估各模型精度。

summary_en.motivation: The fatigue behavior of additively manufactured Ti6Al4V at elevated temperatures is not well understood, necessitating reliable life prediction models for aerospace applications.
summary_en.method: High-cycle fatigue tests were conducted on SLM Ti6Al4V at 400°C under stress ratios from -1 to 0.8, and composite models combining fatigue and creep damage were developed using linear damage rule.
summary_en.result: Surface/subsurface defects dominated crack initiation; increased stress ratio reduced fatigue failure area; the composite model provided the best life prediction accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Model predictions were compared with experimental fatigue lives, and the composite model was validated as the most accurate.

papers.title: Influence of heat treatments and hot isostatic processes (HIP) on microstructure and mechanical behavior of Ti-6Al-4V alloy produced by Powder Bed Fusion Using Electron Beam (PBF-EB)
papers.abstract: This study investigates the effects of heat treatments and hot isostatic pressing (HIP) on the microstructure and mechanical behavior of Ti-6Al-4V parts manufactured by electronbeam powder bed fusion.Solution treatment at 950 C, followed by aging at 500-600 C, did not alter porosity.Aging increased the -phase ratio and compensated for the strength reduction induced by ST.All HIP cycles significantly reduced pore size and pore count, with the 800 C/200 MPa cycle yielding the highest average relative density of 99.86 %, resulting in a maximum yield strength of 948 MPa and a maximum ultimate tensile strength of 1013 MPa.An 800 C/200 MPa HIP cycle increased ductility while maintaining strength, owing to limited -lath coarsening.Super-transus HIP at 1050 C/100 MPa transformed columnar grains into equiaxed structures, causing significant -lath coarsening, a loss of mechanical strength, and increased anisotropy.These findings emphasize the need to optimize post-processing to balance porosity elimination, microstructural refinement, and mechanical performance in Ti-6Al-4V components.K e y w o r d s : additive manufacturing, Powder Bed Fusion Using Electron Beam (PBF-EB), Ti-6Al-4V, heat treatment, hot isostatic pressing

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了热处理和热等静压对电子束粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V合金力学性能的影响，完全符合后处理控制方向。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not include fatigue testing, only tensile properties, so it does not fully address the fatigue aspect of the direction focus.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理和热等静压对PBF-EB Ti-6Al-4V微观结构和力学行为的影响
summary_zh.method: 进行不同热处理和HIP工艺，表征微观结构并测试拉伸性能
summary_zh.result: 800°C/200 MPa HIP提高密度、强度和延展性；超固相HIP导致组织粗化和强度损失
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸实验验证力学性能变化

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effects of heat treatments and hot isostatic pressing on the microstructure and mechanical behavior of Ti-6Al-4V produced by electron beam powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: Various heat treatment and HIP cycles were applied, followed by microstructural characterization and tensile testing.
summary_en.result: HIP at 800°C/200 MPa improved density, strength, and ductility, while super-transus HIP caused grain coarsening and strength loss.
summary_en.validation: Experimental tensile testing validated the mechanical performance.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了Ti-6Al-4V的循环热处理后处理，但未涉及力学性能测试。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical property testing (fatigue/tensile) or explicit correlation to fatigue performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究循环热处理对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V显微组织和球化行为的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用循环热处理工艺处理样品，通过微观表征分析组织演变。
summary_zh.result: 循环热处理促进了α相的球化，细化了组织。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜和X射线衍射进行微观结构观察。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of cyclic heat treatment on the microstructure and globularization of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Cyclic heat treatment was applied to AM Ti-6Al-4V samples, and microstructural evolution was characterized.
summary_en.result: Cyclic heat treatment promoted globularization of the α phase and refined the microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural analysis was performed using SEM and XRD.
